study type: Secondary data analysis of a cohort study
outcome: Labour duration (total, first stage, second stage)
finding: Women with no analgesia had the shortest labor duration and the highest chance of spontaneous birth.
mod_finding: Women with epidural analgesia and women with both opioid and epidural analgesia had a prolonged first and second stage of labor and a decreased chance of spontaneous birth compared to women without analgesia.
